```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
options(scipen=999)
```

This script plots the number of Ensembl Regulatory Features identified with the Ensembl Regulatory Build
and released in [Ensembl 114](https://ftp.ensembl.org/pub/release-114/regulation/).


```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
```

The first step is to load the summarised data describing the number of feature per feature type for each species. 

The file containing this data is available in the [data](data) folder.

```{r}
data_folder <- "data"
read.delim(paste(data_folder, 'rfs_summary_e114.tsv', sep = '/'), 
           header = T, sep = '\t') -> rfs_summary
rfs_summary %>% 
  head()
```

Parsing the species names for a better display. 

```{r}
species_names <- c('Human', 'Mouse', "Pig", "Chicken", "Cattle", 
                   "Atlantic \n salmon", "Turbot", "European \n seabass", 
                   "Rainbow \n trout", "Common \n carp")

names(species_names) <- c('Homo_sapiens', 'Mus_musculus', 'Sus_scrofa', 
                          'Gallus_gallus', 'Bos_taurus', 'Salmo_salar', 
                          'Scophthalmus_maximus', 'Dicentrarchus_labrax', 
                          'Oncorhynchus_mykiss', 'Cyprinus_carpio_carpio')
rfs_summary %>% 
  mutate(species = factor(species, levels = names(species_names), 
                          labels = species_names)) -> rfs_summary

rfs_summary %>% 
  head()
```

Parsing the feature type for a better display. 

```{r}
feature_types <- c("promoter",  "enhancer", "CTCF binding site",  
                   "open chromatin" )

names(feature_types) <- c("promoter", "enhancer", "CTCF_binding_site", 
                          "open_chromatin_region" )

rfs_summary %>%
  mutate(type = factor( type, levels = names(feature_types),
                        labels = feature_types)) -> rfs_summary
rfs_summary %>% 
  head()
```

```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=9, dpi = 300}
rf_colors <- c('promoter' = '#ff0000', 'enhancer' = '#faca00', 
            'CTCF binding site' = '#40e0d0', 'open chromatin' = '#d9d9d9')

rfs_summary %>%
  ggplot(aes (x = species, y = n, fill = type)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = 'identity', position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.9,0.9), 
        legend.background = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(vjust = 0.5),
        panel.grid = element_blank()) + 
  labs(fill = '', x = '', y = 'Number of annotated regulatory regions') + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = rf_colors) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 400000), breaks = seq(0, 400000, 50000),
                     expand = c(0,0)) -> Figure_1_b
Figure_1_b

```
